label: Allied Telesis AT-x530-10GHXm
description: Allied Telesis AT-x530-10GHXm compact stackable L3 switch: 8x 100M/1G/2.5G/5G PoE++ RJ-45 ports at up to 90 W each (720 W budget), 2x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 120 Gbps switching fabric, 89 Mpps.

poe.note: 720 W total, quoted by the vendor as 90 W x 8, from two fixed 500 W supplies. Every one of the 8 copper ports is a PoE++ (802.3bt) PSE port: 15.4 W PoE, 30 W PoE+, 60 W and 90 W PoE++ to 8 powered devices, PD classes 0-8, Mode A and Mode B wiring. The 720 W ceiling is the binding number, not the 1000 W of supply capacity: 8 x 90 W is all the PoE the chassis declares.

fabric.note: Vendor switching-fabric figure (forwarding rate 89 Mpps), the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates: 2 x (60000 Mbit/s of line rate).

notes: The compact half-width box: 441 x 421 x 44 mm, 6.6 kg, rack-mount ears included. The 8 x 100M/1G/2.5G/5G copper ports are ports 1-8 and the two SFP+ cages are ports 9 and 10 (9/S1 and 10/S2, the VCStack stacking ports by default). 2.5G/5G on copper is 802.3bz multi-gigabit, so a 2.5G link fits on Cat5e already in the wall. Two fixed non-replaceable PSUs; 73 W with no PoE load, 970 W fully loaded. Both SFP+ cages can be configured as 1G/10G Ethernet ports once VCStack is disabled. Console is the front-panel RJ-45 RS-232 port (AlliedWare Plus default 9600 8-N-1, no flow control; the switch ships with the manager/friend logins), reached with the RJ-45-to-DB-9 cable in the box or an AT-VT-Kit3 USB-to-serial cable. The management panel also carries a USB port and the eco-friendly button; neither is a network interface, so neither is modelled. Numbers: the x530 Series datasheet SPECIFICATIONS and Power and Noise tables and the model page at https://www.alliedtelesis.com/us/en/products/switches/x530-series; port numbering from the x530 Quick Installation Guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/file/2022-03/ati-x530-english-qig.pdf) and, for the 10/18/28GSX/DP port fronts, the VCStack installation guide (https://www.alliedtelesis.com/sites/default/files/documents/installation-guides/ati_x530_vc_stacking_ig.pdf).
